description_en: Transcodes a video by using a China Production Studio (China Production Studio) for preprocessing
description_zh: 调用本接口通过导播台对视频进行转码处理
kebab_example: aliyun vod submit-preprocess-jobs --video-id d3e680e618708efbf2cae7cc93120000 --preprocess-type LivePreprocess --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitPreprocessJobs

parameters.help_en:
The video ID. You can obtain the video ID by using one of the following methods:
For videos uploaded through the console, log on to the ApsaraVideo VOD console (https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and choose Media Files > Audio/Video to view the video ID.
When you upload a video by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55407.html operation, the video ID is the value of the VideoId parameter in the response.
After the video is uploaded, you can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86044.html operation to query the video ID, which is the value of the VideoId parameter in the response
parameters.help_zh:
视频ID。可通过以下方式获取：
通过控制台上传的视频，可登录点播控制台 (https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择媒资库 > 音/视频查看视频ID。
通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55407.html接口上传视频时，视频ID为返回参数VideoId的值。
视频上传后，可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86044.html接口查询视频ID，为请求后返回参数VideoId的值
parameters.name: video_id

parameters.help_en: The preprocessing type. Set the value to LivePreprocess (video preprocessing for the China Production Studio)
parameters.help_zh: 预处理类型。取固定值：LivePreprocess（导播台视频预处理）
parameters.name: preprocess_type
